subject: Intro request: EU hospital network reference for PrecisionHealth POC
messages:
From: Julian Weber <julian.weber@precisionhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: reference call with EU hospital customer re: Redwood POC

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at PrecisionHealth is in late-stage evaluation and we have tight timelines to close a POC with our pilot hospital network. Our procurement and clinical teams would benefit from speaking with a reference who has run Redwood in a regulated hospital environment (EMR integration, on-prem private deployment, strict latency SLAs).

Can you connect us with an EU customer (ideally an academic hospital) who can speak to:
- deployment timeline and coordination with their IT/security teams
- observed latency and reliability in production (95th percentile)
- data handling controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs)

We aim to schedule a 30–45 minute call next week (Mar 22–24). Also please send any one-page reference brief or an NDA if needed.

Thanks,
Julian Weber
Head of Product, PrecisionHealth
julian.weber@precisionhealth.com
[Attachment: security-ask.xlsx (Excel)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Weber <julian.weber@precisionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:04:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: reference call with EU hospital customer re: Redwood POC

Hi Julian — happy to help and congrats on getting to this stage.

Quick summary of options we can offer for a reference call:
1) Dr. Elena Moreau, Head of AI, St. Agnes Hospital (France) — ran a private deployment during their imaging triage pilot; can speak to EMR hooks and latency tradeoffs.
2) Regional ops lead from Nordica Health (Germany) — focused on orchestration with their on-prem GPU cluster (good for questions about dedicated capacity).

My recommendation is Dr. Moreau for your ask (clinical + security context). She’s agreed to a short intro call in the past with appropriate NDAs and a one-pager.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm preferred slot window (Mar 22–24) and I’ll coordinate availability with Dr. Moreau.
- I’ll send a two-page reference brief and a minimal mutual NDA (if required) — attached is a concise prep brief.

Slots we can offer (CET):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Mar 24, 14:00–14:45

If these don’t work, tell me your priorities (clinical vs infra emphasis) and we’ll pick the right contact.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Exec — EU|Healthcare
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: PH-Ref-Prep.pdf (PDF)]

Laura / Hannah — quick note from my side: I spoke to Elena this morning; she is open to a 30–40 minute call and prefers Wed 24 Mar at 14:00 CET. She asked that we avoid sharing raw performance logs in advance — high-level percentiles and the deployment workflow are fine.

Two items to flag before intro:
- Legal needs a short covering note for the reference call (I can loop in our legal ops to approve the one-pager).
- If PrecisionHealth wants copies of SLO targets we should send the sanitized 95/99 P50 numbers rather than full traces.

I’ll prepare the mutual NDA template if PrecisionHealth requests it; Laura, want me to attach the latest PH-POC-SOW-v1.pdf as optional read-ahead?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks, Laura and Marissa — Wed Mar 24 at 14:00 CET works for our team. Please send a calendar invite and a short reference brief; we will pass along our standard mutual NDA if needed (I attached the procurement checklist previously).

Two quick asks for the call agenda so we can prep stakeholders:
1) 10–12 mins: clinical use case + success metrics (St. Agnes)
2) 10–12 mins: infra & integration (on-prem/private setup)
3) 5–10 mins: compliance & audit log discussion

We’ll bring our Head of Procurement and CTO. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
